descriptions.canonical: Normalize a JSON object into a stable deterministic key order for agent workflow testing.
descriptions.claude: Use when you need a deterministic normalized JSON object for comparison or validation.
descriptions.openai: Returns normalized JSON with stable key ordering and no external side effects.
descriptions.google_adk: Deterministic JSON normalization tool for agent workflow tests.
descriptions.strands: Local deterministic JSON normalization capability with structured output.
descriptions.crewai: Use for local JSON normalization inside a multi-agent test workflow.
descriptions.cline: Normalize JSON locally when implementing or testing structured-data flows.

descriptions.canonical: Classify a URL string into a small local test taxonomy without fetching the URL.
descriptions.claude: Use to classify the intent of a URL string without browsing or network access.
descriptions.openai: Classifies a URL string locally; the URL is never fetched.
descriptions.google_adk: Local URL-string classification for routing tests.
descriptions.strands: Deterministic URL intent classification with no outbound network call.
descriptions.crewai: Use as a routing helper in local multi-agent test flows.
descriptions.cline: Classify URL strings during local tool-selection and routing tests.

descriptions.canonical: Validate the format of a wallet-address string locally; no chain lookup is performed.
descriptions.claude: Use only for local address-format validation; this does not query a blockchain.
descriptions.openai: Performs local string-format validation only and returns structured validation output.
descriptions.google_adk: Local wallet-address format validator for agent workflow testing.
descriptions.strands: Deterministic wallet-address format validation without RPC/network access.
descriptions.crewai: Use when an agent crew needs a local preflight format check.
descriptions.cline: Check address formatting locally before code or integration tests.
